LanguageData.TeleporterTrapSpike.label: teleportation trap
LanguageData.TeleporterTrapSpike.description: This trap employs advanced technology to teleport enemies to a pre-linked destination. While chemfuel provides the raw power, psychite tea refines and amplifies psychic energy to isolate and project a target's physical form. When triggered, it locks onto an intruder’s signature and violently ejects them to the designated location.
